name: CISAPRIDE 10 MG 30 TABLETS
description: Cisapride 10 mg, in a 30-tablet presentation, is a prokinetic medication used to improve gastrointestinal motility and treat disorders such as gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD) and gastroparesis. It increases the coordination of digestive tract movement, relieving symptoms such as heartburn, indigestion, and bloating. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
